Hey folks, I'm not sure where to put this, so I'm messaging you all to see if you can help. Becca is seeing some challenges with post tagging. I', sure sure if this is a human or automated issue.  Below is her note. Can you let me know if this sounds familiar and if you know the cause?

Also, let me know if someone else should also be on this thread.

"TAGGING: There have been some odd things happening in the sheet [view figures not updating, some stories  being tagged as different things on IG + TIKTOK]. Could i ask that the team have another look at it."

messages.text:
There’s a known issue with the tag update pipeline - older tags aren’t getting fully updated, and some updates are only partial. We’re also not archiving the sheets as expected. That is what gives the appearance of things being weird.

I'm planning to have this looked at by Redsella soon.
